observedCase.interpretation: The retry was not text-identical. This is an observed format-rejection compatibility fix; exact cost savings, task-quality effects and speed gains are unproven.

behavior: Only a beginless input starting with a valid file operation and containing one explicit final End marker is eligible after existing outer-whitespace/heredoc handling.
The existing strict core parser validates the complete recovered body; the only inserted text is the opening marker.
Missing or truncated End markers are never invented. Stray prose, beginless code fences, duplicate End markers and malformed recovered bodies are rejected.
Already marked input is forwarded unchanged, preserving existing marked-patch behavior.
The active legacy engine tool retains path, ownership, permission, context and write validation. Successful recovery adds only recoveredMissingBegin=true metadata.
scope: Pure shared core helper plus the active legacy engine parser/tool. The core V2 apply-patch tool is unchanged.
validationExecutedBy: coordinator; no Bun rerun during evidence publication

validation.check: Engine patch parser and tool suites after fixture correction

initialValidation.cause: Two new tests assumed a Git worktree, while the default non-Git fixture resolves the worktree at the filesystem root. This invalidated relative-path and external-directory assertions.
initialValidation.correction: Enabled git:true only for those two new fixtures; assertions and production behavior were not weakened. Final rerun passed all 53 tests.
